Metadata.Comments: Source: 'A Malayalam English Dictionary - Hermann Gundert' (Malayalam, 1872), Gpura archive, IIIF canvas 300, printed page 864. Layout and readings come from ocr/p300.lines.json: line boxes detected automatically (projection profiles); TextEquiv index=1 is Gpura's existing OCR text for the line, aligned automatically and NOT reviewed; index=2 is the Tesseract reading used for the alignment (mal+eng) with its mean word confidence; index=3 (where present) is Gpura's string before the corpus encoding rules were applied. Coordinates are pixels of the full-resolution scan (1362 x 2045) assumed identical to the IIIF full/max image. Line-level flags (underlined/unclear/damage/inkOver/hyphenEnd) are in TextLine/@custom (Transkribus-style 'tag {offset:N; length:M; ...}' code-point offsets) with notes in @comments.
